title: Evidence Request Triage Queue (GRC) — Enterprise Security/Compliance
content:
Purpose
- Intake + track customer/prospect evidence requests (SOC 2 report, pen test summaries, policies, diagrams, etc.) through completion.
- This is the single queue used by GRC for prioritization + SLA tracking.

Rules of engagement (please follow)
- Do not attach restricted evidence directly to customer emails. Use the approved evidence release process.
- SOC 2 Type II report and certain security artifacts require an NDA (per playbook). Track NDA status explicitly.
- If a request includes unsupported controls (e.g., “ISO 27001 certified”), do NOT improvise. Use approved alternative language and/or escalate via Exceptions Policy.
- For deal-critical deadlines (<72 hours), tag CISO + assigned analyst in #security-grc and link the row ID.

SLA targets (business days)
- Triage/acknowledge: 1 business day
- Provide standard public/ungated artifacts (FAQ/one-pagers): 1–2 business days
- Provide gated artifacts (SOC 2 report, pen test summary): 3–5 business days after NDA is executed (unless escalated)

Legend
- Evidence sensitivity: Public / Customer-shareable / Restricted (NDA) / Restricted (Need-to-know)
- Status: New / Waiting on NDA / In progress / With Security Eng / With Legal / Delivered / Blocked / Closed

- ID | Received | Account | Region | Deployment | Due | NDA required | NDA status | Requested artifacts | Sensitivity | Status | Assigned analyst | AE/SE owner | Last update | Next action | Notes

notes_for_analysts:
Common evidence package (default)
- Public/customer-shareable: Enterprise security overview (docs), Security FAQ, data retention/deletion overview, audit logging overview, SSO/SAML/SCIM + RBAC capabilities, subprocessor list (canonical link)
- Restricted (NDA): SOC 2 Type II report, pen test summary, selected policy summaries (as approved)

Escalation triggers
- Due date within 3 business days + NDA not executed
- Customer asks for (a) ISO certification claim, (b) full pen test report, (c) internal runbooks, (d) guarantees on roadmap items

How to reference in external communications
- Always cite artifact name + version/date where possible (or canonical Confluence link internally; customer gets approved PDF/link).
- If you must deviate from standard language, record it in Notes and tag the approver (Security + Legal) before sending.
